author: Found crumpled in a pocket
pages:
#Things to Buy

- 3 sweetrolls (one for me, two for me later)
- cabbage
- leeks (NOT the bad leeks from the stall by the well)
- arrows, the good ones
- new boots (ask about the boots that make you quieter)
- fix sword?? or buy new sword??
- lockpicks (many, many lockpicks)

- potion for that thing
- cheese wheel (whole. no, the WHOLE wheel)
- apologise to the innkeeper about the bench
- find out why the chickens are angry at me
- pay off bounty in the river hold (probably)
- learn to read better so these lists are not so hard to write

#Do NOT Buy

- any more buckets
